items.title: 8.11.1 Applications of Le-Chatelier's principle (Le Chatelier ke usool ke istemal) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.11.1, printed page 179.

blocks.text: Physical aur chemical equilibria par is principle ke sab se aam istemal (applications) yeh hain, jo agle topics mein parhenge:

blocks.alt: Hamari apni drawing: chaar rangeen boxes. Concentration: reactant barhayein ya product hatayein to equilibrium aage (right) jata hai. Pressure: pressure barhayein to equilibrium gas ke kam moles wali taraf jata hai. Temperature: heat dein to endothermic taraf; sirf yahi Kc badalta hai. Catalyst: equilibrium jaldi aata hai, position aur Kc nahi badalte.
blocks.caption: Le Chatelier ke usool ki chaar applications ek nazar mein (hamari apni drawing; kitab mein yeh nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har box ek factor hai. Pehle teen (concentration, pressure, temperature) equilibrium ko kisi taraf shift karte hain, kyun ke system disturbance ka asar kam karna chahta hai. Chautha (catalyst) sirf equilibrium tak jaldi pohanchata hai, shift nahi karta.

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa akela factor equilibrium constant ki value badalta hai, aur baqi factors kya badalte hain?
blocks.explanation: Sirf temperature Kc badalta hai. Concentration, pressure ya volume badalne se sirf equilibrium ki position (mixture ka ratio) badalti hai, Kc wahi rehta hai. Catalyst na position badalta hai na Kc; sirf equilibrium jaldi aata hai.

items: Chaar applications: concentration (8.12), pressure ya volume (8.13), temperature (8.14), catalyst (8.15).
